Usage: agent [options] [command] [prompt...]

Commands:
  install-shell-integration    Install
  uninstall-shell-integration  Uninstall
  login                        Authenticate
  logout                       Sign out
  mcp                          MCP configuration
  plugin                       Plugins
  worker [options]             Worker
  status|whoami [options]      Status
  models                       Models
  bedrock                      Configure
  about [options]              Version information
  update                       Update
  create-chat                  Create
  generate-rule|rule           Rule
  agent [prompt...]            Interactive agent
  ls                           Sessions
  resume                       Resume
  help [command]               Help
  future-headless|future-alias  Synthetic future command

Options:
  --workspace <path-or-name>   Working directory
